notes: The 4.70.0 series-modal nav scrolled to a section while everything else stayed visible — so selecting 🟢 Displayed still showed the whole catalog beneath it, which defeated the point. The nav is now a FILTER, exactly like the indicators rail: every section (Displayed, each catalog category, Statement fields, Valuation bands) registers as a filterable unit; selecting a nav item shows ONLY that section, "All categories" restores the full pane, the selected item highlights, and a selection made before the async catalog loads is applied to its sections when they arrive.
